pilots.name: direct
pilots.note: straight line, gate-window altitude, trimmed cruise

pilots.name: reckless
pilots.note: straight line, full throttle, hard hands

pilots.name: surfer
pilots.note: altitude plan + lift riding/circling + storm/sink avoidance, cruise speed

pilots.name: eco
pilots.note: best-range speed, circles lift to bank energy, idle glides

pilots.name: eco-naive
pilots.note: eco speed policy (best range, idle glide to the gate) on the straight line, blind to the weather

pilots.name: surfer-smooth
pilots.note: surfer without circling or lift riding: plan + avoidance only

pilots.name: surfer-fast
pilots.note: full throttle + altitude plan + avoidance (the weather-aware reckless)

pilots.name: surfer-jet
pilots.note: surfer forced to climb to the jet core (or its ceiling) whatever the plan says
